steps.text: Early evening, at your place. After resting together, you head into the kitchen to prepare dinner.
What can I do?
You're my guest. You can sit there and judge my cooking.
Your guest can chop a vegetable. Give me a board.
All right. The vegetables are yours.
And you can sit down while I do them.
You're taking over my kitchen already.
Only the chopping. You promised me dinner, so the sauce is still your problem.
{{name:lena}} washes and chops the vegetables while you prepare the sauce. You take a seat between tasks, and she brings the plates to the table once dinner is ready.
DINNER
Evidence that you actually cooked for me
And that you stole a piece before I served it
Quality control
Verdict?
Very good. I'm keeping the cook
That's a relief
Now taste it before your food gets cold.
After dinner, you bring dessert to the sofa. {{name:lena}} folds her legs beside you, carefully avoiding your sore leg. You put on a film, but keep pausing it to talk.
LATER THAT EVENING
Come here a second.
You lean closer and kiss her. {{name:lena}} draws you closer, smiling against your lips
A LITTLE LATER
One more for today
You look very pleased with yourself
I had a park date, dinner, dessert, and a very good seat on your sofa
Good seat?
Right beside you
Though I think I've been leaning on your arm for twenty minutes
Worth it
Tell me if your leg starts bothering you, okay?
It's fine like this
Then I'd like to stay a little longer
I'd like that too
You leave your phones on the table and settle back together. The rest of the evening passes in conversation and kisses. When {{name:lena}} eventually leaves, you walk her to the door.
LATER
Home ❤️
Thanks for letting me know
I left my bag beside your sofa
I found it
Good. An extremely convincing reason to come back
You don't need a reason
I know. I still want my bag 😌
Did the dinner live up to the promise?
Yes
But the best part was being there with you
And kissing you goodbye without wanting to go anywhere
I nearly asked you to stay
I nearly went back inside
Next time, ask me 🤍
I will
Now get some rest. You've done more today than you have in a while
Already in bed
Goodnight, love. Thank you for today ❤️
Goodnight. I loved having you here
